boards.prompt: Create one premium high-fidelity iPhone UI redesign image for Hash Fleet's miner detail page, based on the attached real app screenshot of Little Supra. This is a proposed design mockup for later implementation, not a screenshot of working software. Produce a single flat portrait screen, 1206x2622 proportions, edge-to-edge UI without a phone frame. Preserve actual product semantics: Bitcoin miner management, demo data clearly marked DEMO / READ ONLY, miner Little Supra, 638 GH/s hashrate, BM1368, CKPool, accepted 13,926 and rejected 3, 0.02% rejection, best share18.4G and session9.2M. These numbers are sample telemetry, not financial earnings. Design direction: sophisticated native iOS26 industrial instrument panel, deep graphite background #0B0D0F, layered graphite cards not the harsh white hero in the reference, restrained warm amber #FFB13B, very legible SF Pro typography with monospaced numerals, restrained frosted-glass navigation controls only. Clear compact top navigation with back, miner name, refresh and more. A modest amber DEMO label and subdued synthetic address supra-demo.invalid. Main hashrate hero large numeric 638 with smaller GH/s and tiny amber sparkline. A compact horizontal secondary stats row Accepted / Rejected / Rate. Then a two-column thermal/power row with sample Temperature 58°C and Power 10.8 W, explicitly sample data. A Best shares card with both metrics and small explanatory copy that a share is not a mined block. Replace overwhelming 4 giant quick-action tiles with a compact Control miner section: Tuning and Cooling prominent reviewed-draft navigation buttons, Pools and Diagnostics secondary rows. Restart separate outlined action with confirmation affordance, not a dangerous one-tap switch. No false live-connected claims. Bottom native floating tabbar Fleet selected amber, Settings, About, with content ending above it. Generous but efficient spacing, 20pt page gutters, 20pt card radii, strong readable hierarchy, actual polished production UI rather than sci-fi or decoration. Keep all text readable and correctly spelled. Include subtle top statusbar 9:41. No commentary or external annotations in the image.
